findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. These values can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, deployment metadata, or Lambda configuration access, enabling unauthorized use of the associated AWS principal.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime. Unsupported runtimes no longer receive security fixes, leaving the function exposed to known runtime vulnerabilities.
